OFFICE MEMORANDUM

Subject: Filling up the post of Director General, National Library, Kolkata, a subordinate
organization under the Ministry of Culture on deputation (including short term contract) basis -
reg.

The undersigned is directed to refer to the subject cited above and to say that the
Ministry of Culture proposes filling up of 0l vacancy of post of Director General (National
Library) in the Ministry of Culture in Level — 5 (Rs.4,82,200 - 2,24,00) in the revised pay
matrix of 7" CPC, on deputation (including short term contract) basis, from amongst officers
under the Central Government or State Government or Union Territory Administrations or
Statutory or Autonomous Organizations and Subordinate Offices or Central or State Universities
or Research Institutions :-

a. (i) holding analogous posts on a regular basis in the parent cadre or department; or (ii) with
three years service in the grade rendered after appointment thereto on a regular basis in the
post in the scale of pay of Level-i4 (Rs.i,44,200 - 2,i8,200) or equivalent in the parent cadre
or Department; and

b. Possessing the following educational qualifications and experience, namely:

database management out of which five years experience shall be in the administration.

The National Library, Kolkata invites applications from Retired Central Government Officers for

2, The contract will be initial ly for a period of One year which may be extended by competent authority of
the National Library, Kolkata with the approval of the administrative Ministry, subject to satisfactory
performance of such person.

The engagement of consultant would be on full-time basis and they would not be permitted to take up
any other assignment during the period,

The engagement of consultants would be purely on temporary basis and can be cancelled at any time by
the competent authority of tlie National Library without assigning any reason,

3, Age Limit: Not beyond 63 years.

4. Duties: The Consultant will be required to deal with Administrative, legal/court cases, Establishment,
Accounts, procurement of goods and Services, public grievance matters etc.
The Consultant will also be required to complete any other tasks assigned by the competent

authority/senior officers of the National Library, Kolkata, as and when required,

5. Working Hours: The Consultants shall have to work as per the working hours of the National Library.
However, depending on the exigency of work, one may be required to come early or sit late to complete the
time bound work or attend office on holidays. No extra remuneration or fee would be payable if work
requires late sitting or coming on holidays,

Page l of 3

 
6. Allowances:
No increment and Dearness Allowance shall be allowed during the term of the contract. The

consultants shall not be entitled to any other allowance such as Dearness Allowance, Residential
Telephone, Residential Accommodation, HRA, Personal Staff, CGHS and Medical Reimbursement etc.

An appropriate and fixed amount as Transport Allowance for the purpose of commuting between the

residence and the place of work shall be allowed, not exceeding the rate applicable to the appointee at the
time of his/her retirement. No Dearness Allowance shall be admissible on the Transportation Allowance,

No TA/DA shall be admissible for joining the assignment or on its completion. However, the
Consultants would be entitled to draw TA/DA for work-related travel as per his/ her last entitlement at the
time of retirement as per the Government norms and extant rules, in case he/she is deputed for official
work outside Kolkata, the place of work.

7. Tax Deduction at Source: The Income Tax or any other tax will be deducted at source as per
Government instructions,

8. Leave: Consultants shall be eligible for paid leave of absence and may be allowed at the rate of .5
days for each completed month of service. Accumulation of leave beyond a calendar year may not be
allowed.

However, absence during bandh, strike, lockdown should be dealt with a similar way as in the case of
serving officers as these events are beyond the control of any individual,

If retired officer on contract basis remain absent beyond paid leave in a month for reasons other than
those indicated above, his/her remuneration shall be deducted on pro-rata basis,

9. Confidentiality of data and documents: The Consultants shall not utilize or publish or disclose or
Part to third party any data or statistics or proceedings or information gathered during the course of this
assignment. Before hiring Consultants are also required to sign a non-disclosure undertaking as per
